rule: Every SG-009 card fact resolves to exactly one SG-010 fact (same chart id + row label slug). New SG-010 facts have no predecessor and are listed separately. Card IDs QC-001..QC-064 and area groups are unchanged.

SG-009:dwv:before-and-during-flow.status: same row label; SG-010 text revised

row: Basin / disposal
Observe visible joints before, during and after supervised fill/drain. Check accessible waste and electrical connections.
Do not load to overflow, reach into a disposal or infer an old stain is active leakage.
Bath / return below
Separate hot/cold, flow, drainage and leakage. Return below fixtures after safe operation.
Visible tile or a dry short test does not verify concealed waterproofing.
Dishwasher
Observe primary-function cycle and accessible drainage; record stage reached, connection and loop/air-gap evidence.
Do not assume a hidden factory loop or leave a running unit unattended. Match model and local rule.
Laundry / exhaust
Check accessible hoses, duct, termination and lint. Arrester and expansion control are different devices.
Braided hose is not permanent. Both dryer fuels carry lint/fire risk; CO is a combustion concern.
Heat pump / backup
Identify model and mode; distinguish moved heat from auxiliary resistance heat.
Record conditions and limits; do not force controls or infer capacity from temperature alone.
Hot water
Boiler / expansion / pump or gravity / zones / radiators or radiant loop.
Record visible pressure, leakage and normal response; use actual appliance data.
Hydro-air
Water heating coil + blower; refrigerant coil may share the cabinet.
Trace the correct fluid, control and condensate path.
Find the boundary
Identify ceiling versus roofline, floor versus crawl perimeter and the conditioned spaces.
No blanket missing-vent or uninsulated-framing conclusion.
Respect material / access
Suspected vermiculite, unsafe footing, exposed wiring or inaccessible regions change the method.
Leave suspect material undisturbed; record extent and obtain appropriate follow-up.
Separate controls
Insulation slows heat; an air barrier limits airflow; a vapor retarder limits diffusion.
Position and permeability depend on climate and the whole assembly.
Trace ventilation
Follow intake, outlet, baffles and the actual fan/duct/termination.
Net free area is product-specific. Powered airflow can interact with conditioned space and combustion.
Doors
Operate each accessible door; hinges, latch, lock orientation, damage behind the door.
A lock that traps or needs a key to exit is a safety concern.
Escape opening
Operate fully; clear opening, sill, well, ladder, bars and covers release without key or tool.
Compare with the course values; for an existing house, report an impaired route as a safety concern.
Floors
Name the finish layer; soft, lifted or stained areas at wet fixtures; what coverings hide.
Suspect older resilient tile stays undisturbed.
Gas / factory-built
Label, vent type, damper held open for gas logs, vent-free rating plate, insert referral.
Match the log set to the firebox listing. Record normal-control operation only.
Masonry hearth
Facing, hearth extension, clearances, firebox, damper, visible flue.
Flue not visible: say so and refer. Do not light fires.
Safety glazing
Hazardous location first; then a permanent mark on each pane.
No mark means unverified. Older glass is a safety concern, not a code finding.
Stairs / guards
Uniform risers, graspable continuous rail, guard at the open side, headroom, winders, light.
Record measured values; older balusters: note temporary protection rather than a blanket replacement.
Fan / stair route
Record insecure support, headroom, handrails, guards and impaired escape.
Do not operate unstable equipment or load-test suspect guards.
GFCI / controls
Record protection, response, reset location and restored state.
Upstream protection can serve an outlet without buttons; operation does not certify hidden wiring.
Smoke / CO
Record the two functions separately: location, visible type, power and date.
A button test is not a calibrated sensitivity test. Missing protection needs a defined action.
Before access
Agree systems/services, safe access, utilities, timing, privacy and report recipient.
A course outline checks coverage; it does not define the contract or certify every condition.
Communicate urgency
State concern, location, appropriate next action and recipient promptly.
Carry the same concern and limitation into the written record.
Specialist boundary
Record the visible concern and the specific unanswered question.
Pool, pest, lead, asbestos, mold or radon services require their own scope, method and qualifications.
